liveNote.message: Live stream: it is recorded from now on, until you stop it.

queueEmpty.message: Nothing in the queue. Paste an address above to start.

historyOff.message: The history is turned off in Settings.

setSegments.message: Segments at a time, per download

setRateHint.message: 0 means no limit. It applies to all downloads together.

setWindowHint.message: For example Mon-Fri 22:00-06:00. Leave empty to download at any time.

setWindowInvalid.message: The schedule is not valid: write days and hours like Mon-Fri 22:00-06:00.

setHistory.message: Keep a history of finished downloads

setHistoryHint.message: Addresses are kept without passwords or tokens.

setCloseToTray.message: Keep running in the tray when the window is closed

setStartAtLogin.message: Start at login, in the tray

setNotifications.message: Notify me when a download ends

folderRelative.message: The download folder must be a full path.

linkHint.message: The vdown-helper extension hands downloads to this app from these browsers (turn on the desktop app in the extension's settings).

linkNone.message: No supported browser was found for this user. Install Chrome, Chromium, Edge, Brave, Vivaldi or Opera, then repair the link.

linkRepaired.message: The browser link was written again.

presetCompatibleHint.message: H.264 and AAC in MP4, up to 1080p: plays everywhere.

presetSmallerHint.message: H.265: about half the size at the same look; older devices may not play it.

presetPhoneHint.message: H.264 at up to 720p: small files for a phone.

presetWebHint.message: VP9 and Opus in WebM, up to 1080p: for web pages.

presetArchiveHint.message: AV1 and Opus in MKV at the original size: the smallest files, slow to make.

codecCopy.message: Keep the video as it is (no re-encode)

encProblemEncoder.message: This encoder cannot make that codec.

encProblemUnavailable.message: That encoder does not work on this computer.

encProblemCopyResize.message: A video that is kept as it is cannot be resized.

encProblemQuality.message: The quality must be between 0 and 51.

encProblemBitrate.message: The bitrate must be between 100 and 200000 kbit/s.

encProblemSize.message: Not a size that can be made.

encProblemAudioBitrate.message: The audio bitrate must be between 32 and 512 kbit/s.

encProblemContainerCodec.message: This container cannot hold that video codec (MKV holds them all).

encProblemContainerAudio.message: This container cannot hold that audio (MKV holds them all).

encNoFiles.message: No files yet: add some from your computer, or use Re-encode on a finished download in the History.

encDetecting.message: Checking which encoders work on this computer…

encCrfHint.message: Lower is better and bigger (18–28 is usual).

encOriginalsKept.message: The original files are not changed: new files go to the download folder.

encFileGone.message: That file is no longer there, or was not chosen here.
